nodes.description: Ownable._owner: private address holding the privileged owner account.
Ownable constructor: sets _owner to _msgSender() of the deployer and emits OwnershipTransferred.
owner(): public view returning _owner; used by the onlyOwner guard.
renounceOwnership(): onlyOwner function that sets _owner to address(0).
transferOwnership(address newOwner): onlyOwner function that reassigns _owner.
onlyOwner modifier: requires owner() == _msgSender(), the central access-control gate.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership checks and initialization.
Context._msgSender(): internal view returning msg.sender.
Context._msgData(): internal view returning msg.data.
Lib_AddressManager.addresses: mapping(bytes32 => address) name-hash to address registry.
Lib_AddressManager.setAddress(string,address): onlyOwner external function writing the registry.
Lib_AddressManager.getAddress(string): external view reading the registry.
Lib_AddressManager._getNameHash(string): internal pure keccak256(abi.encodePacked(name)).
Lib_ResolvedDelegateProxy.implementationName: mapping(address => string) keyed by address(this).
Lib_ResolvedDelegateProxy.addressManager: mapping(address => Lib_AddressManager) keyed by address(this).
Lib_ResolvedDelegateProxy constructor: stores the address manager and implementation name.
Lib_ResolvedDelegateProxy.fallback(): payable external resolving target and delegating all msg.data.
target.delegatecall(msg.data): low-level delegatecall to an owner-controlled registry address, unvalidated code execution in proxy storage context.
newOwner parameter of transferOwnership.
_name parameter of setAddress.
_address parameter of setAddress.
_name parameter of getAddress.
_name parameter of _getNameHash.
_libAddressManager constructor parameter.
_implementationName constructor parameter.

local success flag of the delegatecall.
